npcs.name: The Friendly Face
npcs.description: A cult-affiliated informant who had previously escaped the party. Operated from a booby-trapped safe house. Interrogated and then assassinated by his own clone.

npcs.name: Sylvie
npcs.description: Leader of the cult's smuggling operation. Controls approximately 20 townsfolk.

npcs.name: Bill Tidewater
npcs.description: Lives at the farm that serves as a processing center for the cult.

npcs.name: Pavo
npcs.description: Cook on the party's ship. Had last watch with Yisela.

npcs.name: Yisela Tideborn
npcs.description: Navigator/cartographer on the party's ship. Was on deck during last watch.

npcs.name: Lyssa
npcs.description: Someone with authority at the docks who told watchers to leave the party's boat alone.

npcs.name: Santiago
npcs.description: Crew member who was bad at keeping a stealthy watch. Very obvious when trying to be covert.

npcs.name: Quattro
npcs.description: Crew member monitoring the Mayweather from across the street. Spotted two dock hand watchers.

locations.name: The Safe House
locations.description: Single-story booby-trapped house where the Friendly Face was hiding. Ransacked interior, powder traps on windows, poison dart on interior door, rotted floor with necrotic aura, hidden trapdoor to tunnel network.

locations.name: Underground Tunnel Network
locations.description: Complex network of six earthen tunnels with cold saltwater. Serves as a smuggling grid connecting multiple locations across the area.

locations.name: The Mayweather
locations.description: A suspicious ship at the docks carrying strange chemicals. Being watched by dock hands and monitored by Quattro.

locations.name: The Black Spire
locations.description: A core cult site located in the swamp. Confirmed by the informant as a place where Sylvie has been seen.

locations.name: The Farm
locations.description: A remote farm with a still that serves as a processing center for the cult's smuggling operation. Run by Bill Tidewater.

locations.name: Smoked Eel Tavern
locations.description: A tavern that opens mid-morning. The party needs to visit for information gathering.

locations.name: City Docks
locations.description: Where the party's ship and the Mayweather are docked. One tunnel exit emerges near here with a heavy scent of gillmen.

locations.name: Second Safe House
locations.description: Identical to the first safe house, accessed via the shortest tunnel through a trapped hatch. Where the informant was found sleeping.

locations.name: The Party's Ship
locations.description: The party's own vessel, docked near the Mayweather. Crew members Pavo and Yisela keep watch.

factions.name: Sylvie's Cult
factions.description: A smuggling operation controlled by Sylvie. Involves approximately 20 townsfolk. Smuggles chemicals, soil, and sometimes sick people. Uses clones and magical traps. Has operated for at least three months.

loot.name: Hallucinogen-Laced Poison
loot.description: Poison found on dart traps in the safe house. The same type commonly used by the cult.

plot_threads.title: The Black Spire
plot_threads.summary: A core cult site in the swamp. Confirmed by the informant. Party has not yet visited.

plot_threads.title: The Mayweather Investigation
plot_threads.summary: Suspicious ship carrying cult-related chemicals. Being monitored by Quattro. Dock hands also watching it.

plot_threads.title: Sylvie's Smuggling Operation
plot_threads.summary: Cult smuggling chemicals, soil, and sick people through underground tunnels. ~20 townsfolk involved. Farm serves as processing center.

plot_threads.title: Cult Cloning Activities
plot_threads.summary: The cult uses clones. The informant was killed by his own clone. Attackers who ambushed the party were likely clones too.

plot_threads.title: Unexplored Tunnels
plot_threads.summary: Two of the six tunnels were not explored. Noble district tunnel leads through magical darkness. Full network not yet mapped.

recap.title: No Loose Ends Investigation
recap.summary: The party pursued a loose end — the 'friendly face' informant with cult connections. After finding his safe house ransacked and booby-trapped, they discovered a hidden underground tunnel network used for smuggling. Following the tunnels to a second safe house, they found and interrogated the informant, extracting critical intelligence about Sylvie's cult operations: smuggling through the tunnels, a processing center at a nearby farm, the Black Spire in the swamp, and the use of clones. The interrogation was cut short when the informant was assassinated by his own clone.

key_events.description: Party decided to track down the 'friendly face' informant at 3 AM
Arcane eye scouting revealed the safe house was ransacked
Party split into two teams to breach the booby-trapped house
Magic Mouth triggered a 7th-level Glyph of Warding fireball ambush
Hidden trapdoor discovered beneath a rug, leading to underground tunnels
Party explored six earthen tunnels forming a smuggling grid
Informant found asleep in second safe house and interrogated
Informant revealed cult details: Sylvie, the farm, the Black Spire, ~20 townsfolk
Informant assassinated by his own clone via crossbow bolt to the head
